name: Interacting-Cycle Arrangement Class
definition: Use the oriented bipartite-graph construction on vertices $u,v,a,b,c$ with arcs $u\to a\to v$, $v\to b\to u$, and $v\to c\to u$.
properties: This is a 49-concept convex-realizable ample class on eight coordinates with coefficient dimension 55. Its two minimal directed-cycle supports give diagonal subspaces meeting in the full diagonal, and its coefficient space has homotopy type $S^2\vee S^2\vee S^2$.
